steps.title: Label tubes and set cold rack
steps.instruction: Label for each sample one 2 mL LoBind tube, one 1.5 mL LoBind tube, one Power Bead tube, one spin‑filter column and three 2 mL collection tubes; place a 1.5 mL/2 mL tube rack at 4 °C for later incubations.

steps.title: Weigh calculus into LoBind tube
steps.instruction: Weigh 3 mg–5 mg of dental calculus on an accuracy balance and transfer it into a 2 mL Eppendorf Safe‑Lock DNA LoBind tube.

steps.title: Crush calculus with sterile pestle
steps.instruction: Crush the calculus inside the tube using a sterile metal pestle.

steps.title: Add EDTA and Proteinase K
steps.instruction: Add 250 µL of 0.5 M EDTA and 12.5 µL of Proteinase K (10 mg · mL⁻¹) to the tube.

steps.title: Rotate for decalcification
steps.instruction: Place the tube on a rotator in the dark at room temperature and rotate for 24 h (up to 48 h optional, e.g., over the weekend) until the calculus fully decalcifies and becomes buoyant or disappears.

steps.title: Brief centrifugation
steps.instruction: Remove the tubes from the rotator and briefly centrifuge to collect liquid from the lid.

steps.title: Transfer to Power Bead tube
steps.instruction: Using a 1000 µL pipette tip, transfer the entire contents (supernatant + pellet) to a Power Bead tube.

steps.title: Add C1 solution and mix
steps.instruction: Add 60 µL of C1 solution to the Power Bead tube and invert several times to mix.

steps.title: Vortex horizontally for 10 min
steps.instruction: Secure the tube horizontally on a flat‑bed vortex pad with tape and vortex at maximum speed for 10 minutes.

steps.title: Centrifuge 30 seconds
steps.instruction: Centrifuge at 9 400 × g for 30 seconds at room temperature; ensure the Power Bead tubes can rotate without rubbing (maximum 10 000 × g).

steps.title: Collect supernatant
steps.instruction: Transfer the supernatant (expected 400–500 µL) to a provided 2 mL collection tube.

steps.title: Add C2 solution and vortex
steps.instruction: Add 250 µL of C2 solution to the supernatant and vortex at maximum speed for 5 seconds.

steps.title: Incubate at 4 °C (5 min)
steps.instruction: Incubate the tube on a pre‑cooled rack at 4 °C for 5 minutes.

steps.title: Centrifuge 1 minute
steps.instruction: Centrifuge at 9 400 × g for 1 minute at room temperature.

steps.title: Transfer 600 µL supernatant
steps.instruction: Transfer 600 µL of the supernatant to a clean 2 mL collection tube, avoiding any pellet.

steps.title: Add C3 solution and vortex
steps.instruction: Add 200 µL of C3 solution and vortex briefly.

steps.title: Incubate at 4 °C (5 min)
steps.instruction: Incubate at 4 °C for 5 minutes on the pre‑cooled rack.

steps.title: Centrifuge 1 minute (second)
steps.instruction: Centrifuge at 9 400 × g for 1 minute at room temperature.

steps.title: Transfer 750 µL supernatant
steps.instruction: Transfer 750 µL of the supernatant to a clean 2 mL collection tube.

steps.title: Add C4 solution and vortex
steps.instruction: Add 1.2 mL of C4 solution to the supernatant, vortex at maximum speed for 5 seconds, ensuring the liquid does not exceed the tube rim.

steps.title: Pass solution through spin filter
steps.instruction: Load the mixture onto the spin‑filter membrane and centrifuge; repeat the loading and centrifugation 2–3 times until the entire solution has passed through the filter.

steps.title: Load C5 solution onto filter
steps.instruction: Load 500 µL of C5 solution into the spin‑filter unit.

steps.title: Centrifuge C5 solution
steps.instruction: Centrifuge for 1 minute at 9 400 × g, room temperature.

steps.title: Dry spin
steps.instruction: Perform a dry spin for 1 minute at 9 400 × g, room temperature.

steps.title: Place filter into collection tube
steps.instruction: Place the spin‑filter unit into a clean 2 mL collection tube.

steps.title: Add C6 solution and incubate
steps.instruction: Pipette 100 µL of C6 solution onto the centre of the membrane, incubate for 1 minute.

steps.title: Centrifuge after C6
steps.instruction: Centrifuge at 9 400 × g for 30 seconds at room temperature.

steps.title: Quantify DNA with Qubit
steps.instruction: Remove the spin‑filter unit and quantify 3 µL of eluate using the Qubit dsDNA BR Kit.

steps.title: Final centrifugation
steps.instruction: Centrifuge for 1 minute at 9 400 × g, room temperature.

steps.title: Optional supernatant storage
steps.instruction: Optionally transfer the remaining supernatant to a clean 1.5 mL LoBind tube and store at –20 °C.

steps.title: Optional exogenous fluid removal
steps.instruction: Add 1 mL of 0.5 M EDTA to the tube and rotate on a tube rotator for 15 minutes at room temperature.

steps.title: Clean metal pestle
steps.instruction: Incubate the metal pestle for 2 minutes in a household bleach dilution, then rinse with HPLC‑grade water, wipe dry with a clean paper towel; sterile plastic pestles may be used instead and must be changed between samples.

steps.title: Backup Power Bead tubes
steps.instruction: Save the Power Bead tubes at –20 °C as backup; discard them once extraction success is confirmed.

steps.title: Backup remaining supernatant
steps.instruction: Store remaining supernatant at –20 °C as backup until extraction is verified; discard if successful.

steps.title: Elute DNA from filter
steps.instruction: Load approximately 675 µL onto the spin‑filter unit and centrifuge for 1 minute at 9 400 × g, room temperature.

steps.title: Store eluate
steps.instruction: Store the eluate at –20 °C.

steps.title: Prepare bleach dilution
steps.instruction: Prepare a 1:10 dilution of household bleach (~6 % hypochlorite) in a 50 mL Falcon tube.
